name: Redcap Biters
description: A troop of fist-sized fey creatures who have needle-sharp teeth and conical red caps sealed on their heads with candle wax.

abilities.name: Horde (1d4+2)
abilities.description: When the Biters have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d4+2 physical damage instead.

abilities.name: Ankle Weights
abilities.description: A PC must mark a Stress to move out of the Biters’ Melee range.
